authority.evaluator: Reviewer-controlled host tooling outside guest authority; the local operator must protect the trusted checkout.

numerical.reason: The original emulator fixture only emits a diagnostic marker and exits or loops. It executes no model, numerical operator, logits or probabilities.

held_out.reason: This public fixture validates the harness protocol. It is not a held-out workload and establishes no held-out task quality.

performance.reason: Host elapsed time tests execution bounds only. Kernel boot, GPU execution, inference, latency, throughput, goodput and sustained thermal performance are unavailable.
